sec: Acute variceal bleeding: the step-ladder · p1004

items.q: A patient presents with acute variceal bleeding. The immediate access step in the p1004 flow is:
opts: Arterial line as the first access
items.exp: Acute variceal bleeding flow starts with a large bore IV cannulas alongside the drug arms. (Book p1004)

items.q: The 1st-line vasoactive drug labelled (1st) in the p1004 flow is:
items.exp: Terlipressin (1st) is the printed first-line arm; octreotide follows after the ‘>’ as the alternative. (Book p1004)

items.q: The terlipressin regimen in the p1004 flow is:
opts: 2 mg stat dose → 2 mg Q6h × 48 hours
2 mg Q6h × 7 days without a stat dose
items.exp: Printed as ‘a mg stat dose → a mg Q6h × 48 hours’ — the dose figure is degraded in the print; the intended regimen is the 2 mg stat → 2 mg Q6h × 48 hours shown in Marrow’s slide deck. (Book p1004)

items.q: The octreotide alternative in the p1004 flow is:
items.exp: > IV Octreotide 50 µg stat → 50 µg/hour. (Book p1004)

items.q: ‘In the p1004 flow, IV octreotide is the labelled first-line drug and terlipressin is the alternative.’
opts: False — terlipressin is labelled (1st); octreotide sits after the ‘>’ as the alternative
True — octreotide is the labelled first-line vasoactive drug
False — neither vasoactive drug appears in the acute bleeding flow
True, but only in non-cirrhotic variceal bleeds
items.exp: Terlipressin (1st) is the first arm; the ‘>’ leads to the IV octreotide 50 µg stat → 50 µg/hour alternative. (Book p1004)

items.q: Match the three bullets in the p1004 resuscitation box — 1) Infection prophylaxis  2) Volume  3) Airway … A) Intubation to be considered  B) Replace blood volume  C) Start antibiotics
items.exp: Box: start antibiotics; replace blood volume; intubation to be considered. (Book p1004)

items.q: A variceal-bleed patient is obtunded and gagless on arrival. Which bullet of the p1004 box is activated by this finding?
items.exp: Airway protection: intubation to be considered is the third bullet of the box. (Book p1004)

items.q: Upon failure of drug therapy and resuscitation, the p1004 flow proceeds to endoscopy for:
items.exp: Upon failure → endoscopy : variceal ligation or sclerotherapy. (Book p1004)

items.q: Upon failure of endoscopy, the final step of the p1004 ladder is:
opts: Repeat variceal ligation through a different scope
Surgical mesocaval shunt formation at laparotomy
items.exp: Upon failure → TIPSS (Transjugular Intrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt). (Book p1004)

items.q: All but one of the following are bullets in the p1004 resuscitation box. The odd one out is:
items.exp: The box holds: start antibiotics, replace blood volume, intubation to be considered — the octreotide infusion belongs to the drug arm, not the box. (Book p1004)

items.q: A cirrhotic bleeds from varices; terlipressin + resuscitation fail, and endoscopic ligation fails. The next rung of the p1004 ladder is:
opts: Repeat sclerotherapy with a different kit
items.exp: Ladder: drugs → (upon failure) endoscopy : ligation or sclerotherapy → (upon failure) TIPSS. (Book p1004)
